The map confirms: I'm at (2,7), player at (3,7), and (2,8) below me is '.'. Yet I can't move down. This is bizarre.

Wait — maybe the issue is that the notice board is at (2,7) and I'm overlapping it, and the game engine treats my tile as blocked so I can't initiate movement. But that shouldn't prevent moving to an adjacent free tile.

Let me try a single quick tap of each direction with short ms to see if any registers.
